title: CERN Linac4 直線加速器
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施
summary: 以取代 Linac2、自 2020 年起為 CERN 全部質子束流源頭的 86 m 長 Linac4 為對象，說明為何把注入能量從 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV 並改用 H⁻ 能讓 PS Booster 亮度約加倍，再把 45 keV 離子源、3 MeV RFQ、斬波線、三種 352.2 MHz 加速結構、飛行時間相位掃描、損失與剝離預算、碳膜電荷交換注入與可靠度驗收整合成可交接的加速器紀錄。
summaryEn: For the 86 m Linac4 that replaced Linac2 and since 2020 sources every proton beam at CERN, show why raising injection energy from 50 to 160 MeV with H⁻ ions roughly doubles PS Booster brightness, then integrate the 45 keV source, 3 MeV RFQ, chopper line, three 352.2 MHz accelerating structures, time-of-flight phase scans, loss and stripping budgets, carbon-foil charge-exchange injection and reliability acceptance into a transferable accelerator record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度」與「同步條件、β 與單元長度 βλ」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness" and "Synchronism, β and cell length βλ": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LHC 束流的亮度在注入鏈最前端就被決定：PS Booster 在低能注入時，束流自身的空間電荷使橫向工作點偏移 ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²)，偏移過大就會跨越共振造成發射度成長與損失。把注入能量從 Linac2 的 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV，β·γ² 增加約一倍，同樣的工作點偏移可容納約兩倍粒子。改用帶兩個電子的 H⁻ 則可做電荷交換注入：剝離膜在環內把 H⁻ 變成質子，這是非保守的過程，新進束流可以疊放在已循環束流的相空間上而不受劉維定理限制，多圈累積時損失與發射度成長都比質子隔板注入小。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: LHC beam brightness is fixed at the very front of the injector chain: at low-energy injection into the PS Booster the beam's own space charge shifts the transverse tune by ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²), and too large a shift crosses resonances, growing emittance and causing losses. Raising injection energy from Linac2's 50 MeV to 160 MeV roughly doubles β·γ², so the same tune shift accommodates about twice the particles. Switching to H⁻ ions carrying two electrons enables charge-exchange injection: a stripping foil converts H⁻ to protons inside the ring, a non-conservative process that lets incoming beam be stacked onto the circulating beam's phase space without the Liouville constraint, so multi-turn accumulation produces less loss and emittance growth than proton septum injection. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the proton mass of 938.27 MeV: at 50 MeV γ = 1.0533 and β = 0.3139, so β·γ² = 0.348; at 160 MeV γ = 1.1703 and β = 0.5195, so β·γ² = 0.712.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Linac4 的主要目的是提高 LHC 的對撞能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Linac4's main purpose is to raise the LHC collision energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「CERN Linac4 直線加速器」的「為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: mechanism and system boundary” in “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness" is correct?
options: Linac4 的主要目的是提高 LHC 的對撞能量。
LHC 束流的亮度在注入鏈最前端就被決定：PS Booster 在低能注入時，束流自身的空間電荷使橫向工作點偏移 ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²)，偏移過大就會跨越共振造成發射度成長與損失。
加速腔的電場一直朝前，粒子任何時候進入都會被加速。
optionsEn: Linac4's main purpose is to raise the LHC collision energy.

LHC beam brightness is fixed at the very front of the injector chain: at low-energy injection into the PS Booster the beam's own space charge shifts the transverse tune by ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²), and too large a shift crosses resonances, growing emittance and causing losses.
The cavity field always points forward, so particles are accelerated whenever they arrive.
quiz.explanation: LHC 束流的亮度在注入鏈最前端就被決定：PS Booster 在低能注入時，束流自身的空間電荷使橫向工作點偏移 ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²)，偏移過大就會跨越共振造成發射度成長與損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: LHC beam brightness is fixed at the very front of the injector chain: at low-energy injection into the PS Booster the beam's own space charge shifts the transverse tune by ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²), and too large a shift crosses resonances, growing emittance and causing losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以質子質量 938.27 MeV 計：50 MeV 時 γ = 1.0533、β = 0.3139，β·γ² = 0.348；160 MeV 時 γ = 1.1703、β = 0.5195，β·γ² = 0.712。比值 0.712/0.348 = 2.04，在相同發射度與工作點偏移下，PSB 可接受的每環粒子數約為原來的 2.04 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the proton mass of 938.27 MeV: at 50 MeV γ = 1.0533 and β = 0.3139, so β·γ² = 0.348; at 160 MeV γ = 1.1703 and β = 0.5195, so β·γ² = 0.712. The ratio 0.712/0.348 = 2.04 means that at the same emittance and tune shift the PSB can accept about 2.04 times as many particles per ring. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 PSB 以不同注入強度量測每環粒子數與橫向發射度，畫出亮度曲線（強度對發射度），與 Linac2 時代的曲線比較斜率；同時以工作點量測或模擬求空間電荷工作點偏移，確認在相同 ΔQ 下強度約增加一倍，並核對 LHC 注入所需的亮度目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the PSB measure particles per ring and transverse emittance at several injected intensities and plot the brightness curve of intensity versus emittance, comparing its slope with the Linac2-era curve; obtain the space-charge tune shift from tune measurements or simulation and confirm that intensity roughly doubles at the same ΔQ, then check against the brightness target required for LHC injection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以質子質量 938.27 MeV 計：50 MeV 時 γ = 1.0533、β = 0.3139，β·γ² = 0.348；160 MeV 時 γ = 1.1703、β = 0.5195，β·γ² = 0.712。比值 0.712/0.348 = 2.04，在相同發射度與工作點偏移下，PSB 可接受的每環粒子數約為原來的 2.04 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Using the proton mass of 938.27 MeV: at 50 MeV γ = 1.0533 and β = 0.3139, so β·γ² = 0.348; at 160 MeV γ = 1.1703 and β = 0.5195, so β·γ² = 0.712. The ratio 0.712/0.348 = 2.04 means that at the same emittance and tune shift the PSB can accept about 2.04 times as many particles per ring.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness", which statement holds?
options: 斬波器會浪費束流，所以越少用越好。
只要損失少於總束流的 1%，就不會造成問題。
optionsEn: A chopper only wastes beam, so it should be used as little as possible.
Losing less than 1% of the beam can never cause a problem.
Using the proton mass of 938.27 MeV: at 50 MeV γ = 1.0533 and β = 0.3139, so β·γ² = 0.348; at 160 MeV γ = 1.1703 and β = 0.5195, so β·γ² = 0.712.
quiz.explanationEn: Using the proton mass of 938.27 MeV: at 50 MeV γ = 1.0533 and β = 0.3139, so β·γ² = 0.348; at 160 MeV γ = 1.1703 and β = 0.5195, so β·γ² = 0.712. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 PSB 以不同注入強度量測每環粒子數與橫向發射度，畫出亮度曲線（強度對發射度），與 Linac2 時代的曲線比較斜率；同時以工作點量測或模擬求空間電荷工作點偏移，確認在相同 ΔQ 下強度約增加一倍，並核對 LHC 注入所需的亮度目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the PSB measure particles per ring and transverse emittance at several injected intensities and plot the brightness curve of intensity versus emittance, comparing its slope with the Linac2-era curve; obtain the space-charge tune shift from tune measurements or simulation and confirm that intensity roughly doubles at the same ΔQ, then check against the brightness target required for LHC injection. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只提高直線加速器的流強而不提高注入能量，PSB 注入時空間電荷工作點偏移超過允許範圍，束流跨越整數或半整數共振，發射度成長並在環內損失，下游 LHC 的亮度目標無法達成，還造成環內活化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising linac current without raising injection energy pushes the space-charge tune shift at PSB injection beyond its allowance, the beam crosses integer or half-integer resonances, emittance grows and particles are lost in the ring, so the LHC brightness target is missed and the ring is activated as well.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 PSB 以不同注入強度量測每環粒子數與橫向發射度，畫出亮度曲線（強度對發射度），與 Linac2 時代的曲線比較斜率；同時以工作點量測或模擬求空間電荷工作點偏移，確認在相同 ΔQ 下強度約增加一倍，並核對 LHC 注入所需的亮度目標。
knowledge.textEn: In the PSB measure particles per ring and transverse emittance at several injected intensities and plot the brightness curve of intensity versus emittance, comparing its slope with the Linac2-era curve; obtain the space-charge tune shift from tune measurements or simulation and confirm that intensity roughly doubles at the same ΔQ, then check against the brightness target required for LHC injection.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness"?
options: 在 PSB 以不同注入強度量測每環粒子數與橫向發射度，畫出亮度曲線（強度對發射度），與 Linac2 時代的曲線比較斜率。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。
optionsEn: In the PSB measure particles per ring and transverse emittance at several injected intensities and plot the brightness curve of intensity versus emittance, comparing its slope with the Linac2-era curve.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete.
quiz.explanation: 在 PSB 以不同注入強度量測每環粒子數與橫向發射度，畫出亮度曲線（強度對發射度），與 Linac2 時代的曲線比較斜率；同時以工作點量測或模擬求空間電荷工作點偏移，確認在相同 ΔQ 下強度約增加一倍，並核對 LHC 注入所需的亮度目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the PSB measure particles per ring and transverse emittance at several injected intensities and plot the brightness curve of intensity versus emittance, comparing its slope with the Linac2-era curve; obtain the space-charge tune shift from tune measurements or simulation and confirm that intensity roughly doubles at the same ΔQ, then check against the brightness target required for LHC injection. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只提高直線加速器的流強而不提高注入能量，PSB 注入時空間電荷工作點偏移超過允許範圍，束流跨越整數或半整數共振，發射度成長並在環內損失，下游 LHC 的亮度目標無法達成，還造成環內活化。
knowledge.textEn: Raising linac current without raising injection energy pushes the space-charge tune shift at PSB injection beyond its allowance, the beam crosses integer or half-integer resonances, emittance grows and particles are lost in the ring, so the LHC brightness target is missed and the ring is activated as well.

steps.title: 同步條件、β 與單元長度 βλ：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Synchronism, β and cell length βλ: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “352.2 MHz gaps and cell length” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Linac4 所有加速結構都在 352.2 MHz 工作，這也是 LEP 的頻率，讓它能沿用 LEP 的速調管與波導。粒子必須在每個加速間隙都遇到同一個 RF 相位：在 0 模的 Alvarez 型 DTL 中，相鄰間隙相距 βλ，即粒子在一個 RF 週期飛過的距離；在 π 模結構中相鄰單元相位相反，間距為 βλ/2。由於 β 從 0.08 增加到 0.52，單元沿線逐漸變長，每種結構只在某一 β 範圍內效率最高。同步相位取負值（例如 −20°），讓早到的粒子得到較少能量、晚到的得到較多，形成縱向聚焦，代價是能量增益乘以 cosφ_s。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All Linac4 structures run at 352.2 MHz, the LEP frequency, which lets the linac reuse LEP klystrons and waveguides. A particle must meet the same RF phase at every gap: in a 0-mode Alvarez DTL adjacent gaps are βλ apart, the distance travelled in one RF period, while in a π-mode structure adjacent cells are in opposite phase and spaced βλ/2. Because β grows from 0.08 to 0.52, cells lengthen along the linac and each structure type is most efficient only in a certain β range. The synchronous phase is negative, for example −20°, so early particles gain less energy and late ones more, giving longitudinal focusing at the cost of multiplying energy gain by cosφ_s. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “352.2 MHz gaps and cell length”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m，以 H⁻ 質量 939.3 MeV 計算各段的速度與單元長度：3 MeV 時 β = 0.0797、βλ = 6.79 cm；50 MeV 時 β = 0.314、26.7 cm；102 MeV 時 β = 0.432、36.7 cm；160 MeV 時 β = 0.520、44.2 cm，π 模單元 βλ/2 = 22.1 cm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加速腔的電場一直朝前，粒子任何時候進入都會被加速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cavity field always points forward, so particles are accelerated whenever they arrive." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 同步條件、β 與單元長度 βλ：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Synchronism, β and cell length βλ: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “352.2 MHz gaps and cell length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m，以 H⁻ 質量 939.3 MeV 計算各段的速度與單元長度：3 MeV 時 β = 0.0797、βλ = 6.79 cm；50 MeV 時 β = 0.314、26.7 cm；102 MeV 時 β = 0.432、36.7 cm；160 MeV 時 β = 0.520、44.2 cm，π 模單元 βλ/2 = 22.1 cm。50 MeV 附近一個 DTL 單元：E₀ = 3 MV/m、T = 0.8、L = 0.267 m、φ_s = −20°，ΔW = 3×0.8×0.267×cos20° ≈ 0.60 MeV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m. With the H⁻ mass of 939.3 MeV: at 3 MeV β = 0.0797 and βλ = 6.79 cm; at 50 MeV β = 0.314 and 26.7 cm; at 102 MeV β = 0.432 and 36.7 cm; at 160 MeV β = 0.520 and 44.2 cm, so a π-mode cell is βλ/2 = 22.1 cm. One DTL cell near 50 MeV with E₀ = 3 MV/m, T = 0.8, L = 0.267 m and φ_s = −20° gains ΔW = 3×0.8×0.267×cos20° ≈ 0.60 MeV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三次元量測核對每個漂移管或單元的位置與長度，與設計的 β 沿線分布比較；用珠拉法（bead-pull）量測腔內軸向電場的平坦度與各間隙的相對場強；束流試運轉時以飛行時間法量每段結構出口的能量，與單元長度推算的同步能量比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check every drift-tube or cell position and length by coordinate metrology and compare with the design β profile along the line; measure on-axis field flatness and relative gap fields with a bead-pull; during beam commissioning measure the energy at the exit of each structure by time of flight and compare with the synchronous energy implied by the cell lengths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 同步條件、β 與單元長度 βλ：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Synchronism, β and cell length βλ: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “352.2 MHz gaps and cell length” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以三次元量測核對每個漂移管或單元的位置與長度，與設計的 β 沿線分布比較；用珠拉法（bead-pull）量測腔內軸向電場的平坦度與各間隙的相對場強；束流試運轉時以飛行時間法量每段結構出口的能量，與單元長度推算的同步能量比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check every drift-tube or cell position and length by coordinate metrology and compare with the design β profile along the line; measure on-axis field flatness and relative gap fields with a bead-pull; during beam commissioning measure the energy at the exit of each structure by time of flight and compare with the synchronous energy implied by the cell lengths. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：DTL 槽內電場沿軸傾斜時，後段單元的實際能量增益偏離設計，粒子逐漸滑離同步相位，出口能量誤差與縱向發射度成長在下一段結構被放大，最後在高能段造成損失與活化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A field tilt along a DTL tank makes energy gain in later cells deviate from design, so particles slip away from the synchronous phase and the resulting exit-energy error and longitudinal emittance growth are amplified in the next structure, finally causing losses and activation at high energy.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The synchronous phase is negative, for example −20°, so early particles gain less energy and late ones more, giving longitudinal focusing at the cost of multiplying energy gain by cosφ_s.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加速腔的電場一直朝前，粒子任何時候進入都會被加速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The cavity field always points forward, so particles are accelerated whenever they arrive." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: DTL 槽內電場沿軸傾斜時，後段單元的實際能量增益偏離設計，粒子逐漸滑離同步相位，出口能量誤差與縱向發射度成長在下一段結構被放大，最後在高能段造成損失與活化。
knowledge.textEn: A field tilt along a DTL tank makes energy gain in later cells deviate from design, so particles slip away from the synchronous phase and the resulting exit-energy error and longitudinal emittance growth are amplified in the next structure, finally causing losses and activation at high energy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「同步條件、β 與單元長度 βλ」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Synchronism, β and cell length βλ" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
RFQ 只負責加速，聚焦完全靠外部磁鐵。
DTL 槽內電場沿軸傾斜時，後段單元的實際能量增益偏離設計，粒子逐漸滑離同步相位，出口能量誤差與縱向發射度成長在下一段結構被放大，最後在高能段造成損失與活化。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The RFQ only accelerates; focusing is done entirely by external magnets.

A field tilt along a DTL tank makes energy gain in later cells deviate from design, so particles slip away from the synchronous phase and the resulting exit-energy error and longitudinal emittance growth are amplified in the next structure, finally causing losses and activation at high energy.
quiz.explanation: DTL 槽內電場沿軸傾斜時，後段單元的實際能量增益偏離設計，粒子逐漸滑離同步相位，出口能量誤差與縱向發射度成長在下一段結構被放大，最後在高能段造成損失與活化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A field tilt along a DTL tank makes energy gain in later cells deviate from design, so particles slip away from the synchronous phase and the resulting exit-energy error and longitudinal emittance growth are amplified in the next structure, finally causing losses and activation at high energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
